summary: Retest of the iteration 30 fixes. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed. The NG fund server re-check returns 400 for 0000123456. The screenshot link returns 401 with no token or a bad token, 403 with a login token or a token for a different id, and 404 with a correctly scoped token (auth passed). Deleting an account removes its recipients and feedback, and the login fails afterwards. Frontend at 390x844: every requested fix passed. Switching NG->KE clears the phone and name fields, and switching back clears the bank and account fields. The saved KE momo chip shows for Card and is hidden for Crypto. Tapping the chip fills the name and phone. Typing '0123 456 789' or pasting '0123-456 789' gives 0123456789 and the name resolves (TEST ACCOUNT HOLDER, mock). Searching 'Guaranty' finds GTBank; 'zzz' shows 'No banks match "zzz".' The checkbox exposes role=checkbox and aria-checked, which toggles true/false. The feedback tab (346,220 44x48) never overlaps the Pay button or the phone/name inputs at any scroll position. 'Tell us what happened.' appears on an empty send and clears on the first keystroke. No feedback was submitted.
